label: Crew
title: One foot in the stars,
paragraphs: Hey, I’m Lucas. I wrote my first lines of code in 2011 and turned it into my job in 2018. I love turning ideas into living applications, exploring new tech and polishing interfaces that pop.
Today I focus on **front-end** and **UI design**, because I love crafting experiences from A to Z: beautiful, smooth and fun to use.

skills.title: Team spirit
skills.text: Solo at 2 a.m. or unblocking a teammate, both suit me fine.

skills.title: Curiosity
skills.text: A new library, a fuzzy concept? I open a tab and dig in.

skills.title: Adaptability
skills.text: New stack, new context: I adapt fast without cutting corners.

skills.title: Passion
skills.text: Dev isn’t just a job… I’d be coding on weekends anyway.
